review_description: Nick was amazing from get go and explained everything.Install team were great and helpful.They set the app for us and explained us how it works.Can't recommend them highly enough.5 star

We had Nick and the team install stand Alone Solar to our rural shed at Ballandean. The whole experience was 10 out of 10. The installers arrived on time and installed in the day. Full explanation of the operation and testing the system before they left. Any after-service queries have been handled wonderfully by Nick. We are thinking of increasing our battery storage and will not hesitate to use Nick again. I would highly recommend Nick and Countryside Solar if you are thinking of Solar.

After a 2 month delay and finding it very difficult and frustrating in getting installation updates I’m happy with the final result.During the sign on process the salesman was happy to call me two or three times a day even on weekends. Once I signed in he was in contactable.Found it very difficult to extract a start date from them.Finally got hold of the boss, Nick and he gave me a firm date.Tbh just a simple bit of feedback during the process would have allayed my concerns and I would have been happy enough to accept any delays.Once Nick called I was ok with his update and he even gave me a further discount as a sweetener.The hardware installed matched the quote, including the free installation of a smart relay.The installation itself was pretty good and very quickly installed, half a day!  Although my house doesn’t have a crying space and rather than lift sheets to run conduit through to the board they’ve run it on the roof surface. Not a big fan of that.The system is a 13.2 kw using Trina solar vertex panels and a 3 phase 10kw Sungrow inverter.All working good and producing plenty of juice.My only advice to Countryside would be to lift your customer feedback, everything else runs pretty well.

Nick was very helpful and courteous.  He kept in contact about the installation, etc.  Installation went without a hitch and the workers were professional and did the job quickly and well. The work areas were kept tidy.
